faqs.a:
The housing authority, in addition to its other powers, has the power to procure or
               agree to the procurement of insurance or guarantees from the federal government for
               the payment of any debts or parts thereof incurred by said authority, including the
               power to pay premiums on any such insurance.
(Code 1981, § 14-41; Ord. No. 1248, § 23, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-225.
